given.note: On S1-10's secure page Sam types the one owner email for notices, sign-in help and answers by email (FS row B13, required; S1-10). The call keeps the address as a new email handle, the recipient of the code's email row, and as Sam's owner email, not yet proven (K-22's account email), and sends a code there, to be typed back on the page; until then the email is used for nothing (S1-10: 'Until then it isn't used'). The call acts for no person until the code is right: the server keeps whose code it is (K-22, T-031). The code never comes back to the caller. The address is on the reserved .example domain.
